limits: Different flags intentionally compare available noninteractive workflows; --delete-all and --force are not equivalent grants.
D21 local-only commit OIDs differ intentionally; both share the same old trunk ancestor.
C12 is confounded by missing closed-PR association as well as open-ancestor traversal; use C23 to establish the known-closed descendant gap.
Captured snapshots cover local heads/metadata, not every Git/cache/recovery file; REA shows fetch-related writes on GT D21 refusal.
C22 uses --downstack, so delete-all is not global repository cleanup in that case.
No claim is made about Graphite --force, terminal confirmation paths, arbitrary conflicts, frozen cleanup or universal recovery.
